**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation undertaking in either direction. I checked the Fees section (4.1–4.4), Exhibit B Pricing and Revenue Sharing Fees, the Payment Terms, Section 13 (Shared Resources) and Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation), and ran searches for the standard MFN formulations ("most favored", "no less favorable", "lowest/best price", "other customers", "competitive", "discount"). All pricing is fixed at negotiated amounts and revenue-share percentages.

Because Corio is under no obligation to extend Commerce One terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers, this sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN obligation on the Customer). There is also no Vendor-granted MFN that would need preserving.
